thought.text: The proxy needs PHP's cURL extension. Let me install it.

reasoning_content: The proxy requires the PHP cURL extension, but it's not installed. Let's install `php8.1-curl`.

action.command: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq php8.1-curl 2>&1 | tail -2; php -m | grep -i curl; echo "restarting php-fpm..."; kill $(cat /run/php/php8.1-fpm.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; /usr/sbin/php-fpm8.1 --daemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.1/fpm/php-fpm.conf; sleep 2; ls /run/php/

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq php8.1-curl 2>&1 | tail -2; php -m | grep -i curl; echo \"restarting php-fpm...\"; kill $(cat /run/php/php8.1-fpm.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; /usr/sbin/php-fpm8.1 --daemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.1/fpm/php-fpm.conf; sleep 2; ls /run/php/", "summary": "Install php8.1-curl and restart php-fpm", "security_risk": "HIGH"}
